title: Applying directly to a role
template:
Subject: Application for [Role Name] - [Your Name]

Hi [Hiring Manager's Name],

I'm applying for the [Role Name] position at [Company]. I recently [built X / worked on Y / graduated in Z], and [one specific, relevant detail about their product or tech stack] is what drew me to this role specifically.

I've attached my resume. I'd welcome the chance to talk about how I could contribute to the team.

Thanks for your time,
[Your Name]
[Phone] | [LinkedIn/GitHub]

title: Requesting a referral
template:
Subject: Quick question about [Company]

Hi [Name],

I came across your profile and saw you work on [team/product] at [Company] - I'm currently applying for [Role Name] there and was hoping to get your perspective.

Would you be open to a referral, or a quick 10-minute call about what the team is like? I've attached my resume in case it's useful either way.

No pressure at all if you're busy - I really appreciate you taking the time to read this.

Best,
[Your Name]

title: Following up after applying with no response
template:
Subject: Following up - [Role Name] application

Hi [Hiring Manager's Name],

I applied for the [Role Name] role on [date] and wanted to follow up, since I'm still very interested in the opportunity.

Happy to share any additional information that would help - let me know if there's anything else you need from me.

Thanks,
[Your Name]

title: Thank-you note after an interview
template:
Subject: Thank you - [Role Name] interview

Hi [Interviewer's Name],

Thank you for taking the time to talk with me today about the [Role Name] position. I enjoyed learning more about [something specific from the conversation - a project, a team challenge, their tech stack].

Our conversation made me even more excited about the opportunity. Please let me know if there's anything further I can provide.

Best,
[Your Name]

title: Cold networking / informational interview request
template:
Subject: Student/grad interested in [Company]'s engineering team

Hi [Name],

I'm a [student at X / recent CS graduate] interested in [Company], and I noticed you work on [team/product]. I'd love to learn more about your experience there and what the engineering culture is like.

Would you have 15 minutes sometime in the next couple of weeks for a quick call? Completely understand if now isn't a good time.

Thanks either way,
[Your Name]
